newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set for more moderate falls.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set for more moderate falls.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Tuesday hit by a weaker dollar and bond market, with dealers seeing more falls ahead in a market focused on 1996 corporate results.
"More moderate decline seems inevitable on Wednesday. Companies issuing their 1996 results these days will be in focus," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.65 point lower at 158.48, while the KFX March future rose 0.10 point to 157.50 with 818 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Tele Danmark, GN Store Nord and ISS were the most important 1996 results announced, with the telecommunications group closing 13 crowns down at 343 on (expected) lower profits on higher turnover after 109,000 shares changed hands.
GN Store Nord finished 15 crowns down at 680 on 16 percent higher pre-tax profits.
ISS, which posted a heavy 1996 loss due to U.S. problems, forecast a brighter future and ended the day 3.8 crowns higher at 182. Overall turnover for the day was 840 million crowns.
